title: Development of sulfonated polystyrene resin-supported tungsten oxide for Pb2+ ion sequestration
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14158-14169
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01017A, Paper

Kashmala Khaliq, Mohsin Ali Raza Anjum, Shabnam Shahida, Ramzan Akhtar, Adil Khan, Munib Ahmad Shafiq, Iqra Rafiq, Muhammad Rehan, Rashid Nazir Qureshi, Sajid Iqbal, Jong-Il Yun, Muhammad Saifullah
A sulfonated polystyrene resin-supported tungsten oxide (SO3-PSWO) was synthesized and evaluated for its efficiency in removing lead (Pb2+) from aqueous solutions.
